lines.trans: You know, even if the earth split in two, I intended to follow Toru Muranishi.
Even so... after today, I'm quitting the company.
Please have a seat. Here is thirty million yen.
You were right all along. I never should have trusted a word that man said.

words.gram: Plain dictionary form of 言う (to say).
Plain dictionary form of 言う (to say).

lines.trans: I'll recover as many of the bootleg tapes as I can, and I plan to consult the police too.
Thirty million is still a bit short, I know, but please accept this for now.
Isn't this the money you worked for without taking a single day off?
That doesn't matter to me at all. I'm so sorry I couldn't hold the company together.
None of this is your fault.
Won't you please accept the money?
I'm sorry—I can't take it.
Do you regret becoming an adult video actress?

All-purpose action verb; turns Sino-Japanese nouns into verbs (融通する, 出店する) and with に means 'decide on' or 'make into'.

examples.text: そして今度は衛星から地球に電波が降り注ぐ。
examples.trans: And then the signals shower back down from the satellite onto the earth.

meanings.note: Marks the subject of existence, emergence, or questions (どれが), and at the end of a polite clause softens a request (のですが).

examples.text: お願いがあるのですが。
examples.trans: I have a favor to ask.

meanings.note: Attaches to the irrealis (a-stem) of godan verbs.

examples.trans: I was called by the teacher.

meanings.note: Replaces は, が, or を to add 'also' or 'too'.

examples.trans: Please give me this one too.

examples.text: あそこも新しい店です。
examples.trans: Over there is a new shop too.

meanings.en: target, location of existence, or result marker
meanings.note: Marks destination, location where something exists or sits, or the chosen result before する and なる.

meanings.en: go forward; work out well (いけます = 'it will work!')
meanings.note: Written in kana for figurative headway: いけます! ('this can go / this will work!'), 思いどおりにいかない ('does not go as hoped').

examples.text: この企画ならいけます！
examples.trans: With this plan, it will work!

examples.text: 仕事がうまくいっています。

meanings.en: to think; to feel; to believe
meanings.note: Often follows quotative と to express an opinion or belief.

examples.text: それはいいと思います。
お前ら、観光じゃないんだからしっかりしろよ。
examples.trans: Hey, this isn't sightseeing, so pull yourselves together.

examples.text: 彼女は来るんだろうな？
ちゃんとキャストはそろってるんだろうな？
examples.trans: You've got the whole cast properly lined up, right?

meanings.note: Tells the listener something new or adds warm reassurance at the end of a sentence.

meanings.en: whichever (after question word); or something like
meanings.note: After どれ (どれでも) means 'any one at all'; after a noun (店でも) suggests an example ('a shop or something').

examples.text: いつでも来てください。
お茶でも飲みませんか。
examples.trans: Won't you have tea or something?

meanings.note: Special reading きょう.

meanings.en: location of action; means; scope total
meanings.note: Marks where an action happens, the unit/scope of a rate or total (十日で, 全部で), or the cause/occasion.

examples.trans: It is one thousand yen in total.

meanings.note: Everyday word for a business company or one's workplace.

examples.text: 新しい会社に入りました。

examples.trans: The company is near the station.

examples.text: 俺も金なんとか集めるからよ。もうちょっと明るくやろうや。
examples.trans: I'll scrape together some money too, so let's keep our spirits up.

examples.text: ああ。リスクもあるが、懸けてみるか、トシ。
examples.trans: Yeah. There's risk involved too, though—ready to take the gamble, Toshi?

examples.text: 強制送還の金がかかるだけで、何の見せしめにもならないだろ？
examples.trans: Deporting them just costs money and doesn't serve as an example to anyone, right?

examples.text: じゃあ手切れ金と思って受け取れ。
examples.trans: Then take it as severance pay and walk away.

examples.text: ここに書いてください。

meanings.note: Read いちにち for duration/rate ('per day'); read ついたち for the 1st of the month.

examples.text: よかったら来てください。

そんな.gloss: such; that kind of; that much

examples.text: そんな高いものは買えません。
examples.trans: I cannot buy something that expensive.

examples.text: ごめんなさい、もうしません。
